name: In Search of Menara Voidrender

meta.next: Components for the Enchanted Gold Bloodrobe

summary: Zevrost, a cynical warlock trainer lurking in Orgrimmar's Cleft of Shadow, directs seasoned practitioners to seek out Menara Voidrender in the Barrens. Despite his harsh warnings about the inevitable price of demonic corruption, he points ambitious warlocks toward an expert mentor capable of fashioning powerful arcane vestments.

sections.title: Warnings in the Shadows
sections.body: Deep beneath Orgrimmar in the Cleft of Shadow, warlocks operate under a veil of uneasy tolerance. Zevrost is among the more bitter tutors in the dark arts, quick to sneer at ambitious acolytes striving for mastery. In his eyes, anyone delving deeper into fel magic is merely racing toward their own enslavement. He insists that it is only a matter of time before demonic addiction overtakes the practitioner completely, reducing even the most disciplined scholar into a thrall of the Twisting Nether.

sections.title: The Path to Ratchet
sections.body: Despite his contemptuous predictions, Zevrost concedes that other practitioners do not share his dreary outlook. Word has reached Orgrimmar of Menara Voidrender, a skilled warlock stationed on the bluffs overlooking the neutral goblin port of Ratchet. Menara seeks promising disciples to aid in crafting specialized implements to harness their arcane might. For warlocks eager to push their craft further, this summons marks the beginning of forging the legendary Enchanted Gold Bloodrobe.

sections.title: A Pragmatic Fellowship
sections.body: Upon finding Menara high above Ratchet, the nature of warlock society becomes starkly apparent. Menara observes that warlocks must set aside racial and cultural rivalries to support one another, as the demons they bargain with harbor no prejudice and show no mercy to anyone who falters. Sharing expertise and fashioning protective vestments is not done out of noble charity, but as a practical necessity to survive the hostile entities they bind to their service.

aliases: who starts in search of menara voidrender
faq.answer: Zevrost is an orc warlock trainer residing in the Cleft of Shadow beneath Orgrimmar. He is deeply cynical regarding the pursuit of fel power, viewing all ambitious warlocks as fools destined to become slaves to demonic corruption.

Menara Voidrender is an accomplished warlock residing in the Barrens on the cliffs overlooking the goblin port of Ratchet. She acts as a mentor for rising warlocks, helping them gather rare reagents to construct potent ceremonial robes.

faq.q: Why does Zevrost think all warlocks are fools?
faq.answer: Zevrost believes that fel magic inevitably corrupts and enslaves anyone who attempts to master it. In his view, no practitioner has the will to avoid addiction, and striving for greater power merely accelerates their downfall.

faq.q: Where can Menara Voidrender be found?
faq.answer: Menara is stationed in the Barrens, positioned on the high hills overlooking the coastal port of Ratchet. Warlocks must travel east across the arid savannah to reach her overlooking camp.

faq.q: Why do warlocks from different races work together?
faq.answer: As Menara explains, the demonic forces summoned by warlocks show indiscriminately cruel malice to anyone who fails to control them. Because survival depends on absolute precision, warlocks regularly share knowledge and tools across cultural boundaries.

faq.q: What happens after finding Menara Voidrender?
faq.answer: Menara Voidrender immediately enlists the warlock to gather exotic and potent materials across Azeroth to construct the Enchanted Gold Bloodrobe, a protective garment attuned to fel energies.

angles.text: This quest represents a pivotal rite of passage for Horde warlocks, sending them to assemble their own iconic Enchanted Gold Bloodrobe under Menara Voidrender's guidance.
Horde warlocks must constantly navigate the contempt of traditional shamans and warriors, finding shelter only in hidden recesses like Orgrimmar's Cleft of Shadow or neutral ground near Ratchet.
